title: xDrip+ gets "zero slope calibration"  when calibrating through the add treatment dialog
symptom: When adding a BG through the add treatment dialog, the user gets the "got zero slope calibration" error. The error is intermittent, sometimes works through the treatment panel.
cause: The issue is a concurrency issue, which is why it sometimes happens and mostly doesn't.
fix: The fix will be in the next nightly. The developer identified the code which caused it and eliminated it.
evidence_quote: Its down to a concurrency issue which is why it sometimes happens and mostly doesn't. The fix will be in the next nightly.
